consent.title: Allow {client} to use VeloExpense as you?
consent.lede: {client} is asking to act as you in {company}.
consent.claimed: “{client}” is the name the application gave itself. Only allow it if you started this connection yourself.
consent.dataNote: It can never do more than you can. What it reads may be sent to the application’s AI service to answer you. You can disconnect it at any time under Preferences.
consent.returnsTo: After you choose, you go back to {host}.

scope.expense_management_expense_report: Read and work on your expense reports
scope.travel_travel_request: Read and work on your travel requests
scope.collaboration_discussion: Read and post comments on your reports and trips
scope.collaboration_discussion_readonly: Read the comments on your reports and trips

error.title: This connection can’t continue
error.unknown_client: This application isn’t registered here. Start the connection again from the application.
error.bad_redirect: The application asked to return to an address it didn’t register, so nothing was sent to it.
error.missing_params: The link is incomplete. Start the connection again from the application.
error.unavailable: Connecting applications isn’t set up on this VeloExpense yet.
error.expired: This page expired before you chose. Start the connection again from the application.
error.refused: You can’t connect applications with this account.

connected.title: Connected applications
connected.description: Applications you have allowed to act as you through VeloExpense’s MCP server, such as Claude.
connected.confirmBody: It stops working immediately. To use it again, connect it again from the application.

admin.title: Connected applications
admin.description: Every application a person in this company has allowed to act as them, through OAuth (a Claude connector, for example). Disconnecting one stops it immediately.
